arxiv-2006-11378.title: Observation of bifurcations and hysteresis in experimentally coupled logistic maps
arxiv-2006-11378.creator: Caracé Gutiérrez, Cecilia Cabeza, Nicolás Rubido
arxiv-2006-11378.description: Abstract Initially, the logistic map became popular as a simplified model for population growth. In spite of its apparent simplicity, as the population growth-rate is increased the map exhibits a broad range of dynamics, which include bifurcation cascades going from periodic to chaotic solutions.

arxiv-2105-11772.title: Multipole polaron in the devil’s staircase of CeSb
arxiv-2105-11772.creator: Y. Arai, Kenta Kuroda, T. Nomoto, Z. H. Tin, S. Sakuragi, C. Bareille, S. Akebi, K. Kurokawa, Y. Kinoshita, W.-L. Zhang, S. Shin, M. Tokunaga, H. Kitazawa, Y. Haga, H. S. Suzuki, S. Miyasaka, S. Tajima, K. Iwasa, R. Arita, Takeshi Kondo
arxiv-2105-11772.description: Abstract Rare-earth intermetallic compounds exhibit rich phenomena induced by the interplay between localized f orbitals and conduction electrons. However, since the energy scale of the crystal-electric-field splitting is only a few millielectronvolts, the nature of the mobile electrons accompanied by collective crystal-electric-field excitations has not been unveiled.

arxiv-2109-13837.title: Magnetic ground states of a model for (TM)Nb 3 S 6 , TM=Co, Fe, Ni
arxiv-2109-13837.creator: O. Heinonen, R. A. Heinonen, H. Park
arxiv-2109-13837.description: Abstract The transition-metal intercalated dichalcogenide CoNb 3 S 6 is a triangular antiferromagnet that has recently been shown to exhibit a large anomalous Hall effect (AHE) below the Néel temperature, even though the response to an external field is very small.

arxiv-2207-12260.title: Generation and annihilation of skyrmions and antiskyrmions in magnetic heterostructures
arxiv-2207-12260.creator: Sabri Koraltan, Claas Abert, Florian Bruckner, Michael Heigl, Manfred Albrecht, Dieter Suess
arxiv-2207-12260.description: Abstract We demonstrate the controlled generation and annihilation of (anti)skyrmions with tunable chirality in magnetic heterostructures by means of micromagnetic simulations. By making use of magnetic (anti)vortices in patterned ferromagnetic layer, we stabilize full lattices of (anti)skyrmions in an underlying skyrmionic thin film in a reproducible manner.

arxiv-2309-03557.title: On the Dynamics of Multiagent Nonlinear filtering and Learning
arxiv-2309-03557.creator: Sayed Pouria Talebi, Danilo P. Mandic
arxiv-2309-03557.description: Abstract Multiagent systems aim to accomplish highly complex learning tasks through decentralised consensus seeking dynamics and their use has garnered a great deal of attention in the signal processing and computational intelligence societies. This article examines the behaviour of multiagent networked systems with nonlinear filtering/learning dynamics.

arxiv-2310-09926.title: Estimating Uncertainty in Multimodal Foundation Models using Public Internet Data
arxiv-2310-09926.creator: Shiladitya Dutta*, Hongbo Wei*, Lars van der Laan, Ahmed M. Alaa
arxiv-2310-09926.description: Abstract Foundation models are trained on vast amounts of data at scale using self-supervised learning, enabling adaptation to a wide range of downstream tasks. At test time, these models exhibit zero-shot capabilities through which they can classify previously unseen (user-specified) categories. In this paper, we address the problem of quantifying uncertainty in these zero-shot predictions.

arxiv-2403-01679.title: Minimal cyclic behavior in sheared amorphous solids
arxiv-2403-01679.creator: Chloe W. Lindeman, Sidney R. Nagel
arxiv-2403-01679.description: Abstract Although jammed packings of soft spheres exist in potential energy landscapes with a vast number of minima, when subjected to cyclic shear they may revisit the same configurations repeatedly. Simple hysteretic spin models, in which particle rearrangements are represented by interacting spin flips called hysterons, capture many features of this periodic behavior.

arxiv-2411-02536.title: Towards Leveraging News Media to Support Impact Assessment of AI Technologies
arxiv-2411-02536.creator: Mowafak Allaham, Kimon Kieslich, Nicholas Diakopoulos
arxiv-2411-02536.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mowafak Allaham, Kimon Kieslich, Nicholas Diakopoulos. Expert-driven frameworks for impact assessments (IAs) may inadvertently overlook the effects of AI technologies on the public’s social behavior, policy, and the cultural and geographical contexts shaping the perception of AI and the impacts around its use. This research explores the potentials of fine-tuning LLMs on negative impacts of AI reported in a diverse sample of articles from 266 news domains spanning 30 countries around the world to incorporate more diversity into IAs.

arxiv-2412-05387.title: Identification of the initial value for a space-time fractional diffusion equation
arxiv-2412-05387.creator: Mohamed BenSalah, Salih Tatar
arxiv-2412-05387.description: Abstract In this paper, we study an inverse problem for identifying the initial value in a space-time fractional diffusion equation from the final time data. We show the identifiability of this inverse problem by proving the existence of its unique solution with respect to the final observed data. It is proved that the inverse problem is an ill-posed problem.

arxiv-2602-16966.title: A Unified Framework for Locality in Scalable MARL
arxiv-2602-16966.creator: Sourav Chakraborty, Amit Kiran Rege, Claire Monteleoni, Lijun Chen
arxiv-2602-16966.description: Abstract Scalable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is fundamentally challenged by the curse of dimensionality. A common solution is to exploit locality, which hinges on an Exponential Decay Property (EDP) of the value function. pmc-11402351.title: Benidipine Hydrochloride Inhibits NLRP3 Inflammasome Activation by Inhibiting LPS-Induced NF-κB Signaling in THP-1 Macrophages
pmc-11402351.creator: Mengmeng Huo, Wanying Guo, Liqiong Ding
pmc-11402351.description: IntroductionNLRP3, ASC, and procaspase-1 form the multiprotein complex known as the NLRP3 inflammasome. Following the priming of NLRP3 by TLR4 ligand, the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome causes caspase-1 maturation, which results in the release of IL-1β. Calcium channel antagonists are commonly employed as antihypertensive medications and have anti-inflammatory properties through the inhibition of cytokine release, specifically IL-1β.

pmc-12597832.title: Maternal and Neonatal Outcomes in Pregnant Women Vaccinated Against COVID-19 Compared to an Unvaccinated Group
pmc-12597832.creator: Tooba Nourian, Sadra Sarandili, Safa Mousavi, Majid Mirmohammadkhani, Mojgan Rahmanian
pmc-12597832.description: Introduction and ObjectivesImmunizing pregnant women against COVID-19 is crucial due to their heightened risk of severe outcomes. However, data on vaccination’s clinical effects during pregnancy are limited. This study evaluated maternal and neonatal outcomes in vaccinated pregnant women, stratified by vaccine doses, compared to unvaccinated controls.

pmc-12636911.title: Oligoclonal tumor-specific CD8 T-cell revival and IRE1α/XBP1-GDF15-mediated immunosuppressive niches determine neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy efficacy in cervical cancer
pmc-12636911.creator: Guangxu Cao, Yuhan Wang, Huimin Zeng, Yong Zhi, Yi Guo, Mengting Xu, Yetian Ruan, Ying Wang, Yuhang Xiao, Jianqiao Lu, Ka Yu Tse, Jinli Gao, Qingfeng Zhang, Chenfei Wang, Zhiqiang Han, Fang Li
pmc-12636911.description: BackgroundNeoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy (NACI) shows promise for locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC), but drug-tolerant persister (DTP) cells and immunosuppressive microenvironmental adaptations limit clinical efficacy. The underlying determinants governing heterogeneous responses to NACI regimens remain poorly understood, particularly regarding how dynamic tumor-immune interactions shape therapeutic outcomes.

pmc-12659686.title: On the Brink of the Abyss: Managing More Than 25 Liters of Blood Loss During a Cesarean Section
pmc-12659686.creator: Strahil N Kotsev, Nadine B Nour, Muhammad Sharif Allah Dad, Zainab Saeed
pmc-12659686.description: We present a case of placenta percreta in which the patient experienced an intraoperative blood loss exceeding 25 liters. To our knowledge, this represents the highest volume of hemorrhage reported during cesarean section (CS) in which the patient survived. Injuries of the iliac vessels, urinary bladder, and ureter had to be dealt with intraoperatively.

pmc-12795766.title: Mental health first aid certification's impact on Filipino nurses' ability to increase personal help-seeking behaviors, self-awareness of health changes, and improved self-connection

pmc-13038455.title: Photodynamic therapy using talaporfin sodium for grade 2/3 meningiomas: a preliminary study of safety, feasibility, and clinical outcomes
pmc-13038455.creator: Shinjiro Fukami, Jiro Akimoto, Kenta Nagai, Nobuyuki Nakajima, Norio Ichimasu, Ken Matsushima, Sho Onodera, Yuki Saito, Michihiro Kohno
pmc-13038455.description: PurposeAtypical and anaplastic (grade 2/3) meningiomas are associated with high recurrence rates and lack effective systemic therapies other than radiotherapy. Photodynamic therapy (PDT) using talaporfin sodium (TPS) generates selective cytotoxicity extending beyond resection margins and may improve local tumor control.

pmc-13642113.title: Comparing Exciton–Plasmon Couplings in J‐Aggregate and TMD‐Based Hybrids Using Angle‐Resolved Two‐Dimensional Electronic Spectroscopy
pmc-13642113.creator: Daniel C. Lünemann, Daniel Timmer, Antonietta De Sio, Christoph Lienau
pmc-13642113.description: Recent developments in ultrafast two‐dimensional electronic spectroscopy (2DES), a powerful tool to unravel coherent couplings in nanosystems, have enabled studies of strongly coupled collective excitons and surface plasmon polaritons. Here, we report a comparative study of two prototypical systems, plasmonic nanoslit arrays covered with either a J‐aggregated molecular thin film or a transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayer.
